Medicare has two main routes: Original Medicare, which is Parts A and B through the federal program, and Medicare Advantage, which is a private plan that provides Parts A and B. With Original Medicare, you can add a separate drug plan and may be able to add Medigap; with Medicare Advantage, most plans include drug coverage. For costs, the monthly premium is only one piece.
